desc: Simulate all movements, recording inclusive axis-aligned segments and the final coordinates.
Group houses by fixed \(x\) and fixed \(y\), retaining house IDs and sorted varying coordinates.
Group segments by their fixed coordinate and merge overlapping or adjacent inclusive intervals.
Use binary searches to enumerate houses covered by each merged interval and deduplicate with a global visited array.
Confirm \(O((N+M)\log(N+M))\) complexity, endpoint correctness, and large-coordinate safety.
Run and verify both provided sample tests.
